title: Going PLACES: Participatory Localized Red Teaming for Text-to-Image Safety in the Global South
reasoning: The paper includes a significant analysis of 'normative dissonance' and religious safety, specifically identifying harms such as the violation of religious norms, the inaccurate representation of deities, and the depiction of religiously proscribed acts (e.g., gambling in Makkah or eating beef near Hindu idols).
